core.headline: Detached house with indoor pool and triple garage, 2.1 acres
core.summary: Set within 2.1 acres in the Kent Downs National Landscape, a detached house with indoor swimming pool, triple garage and three reception rooms. Guide Price £1,250,000 freehold.
core.listing:
Hollybank stands within approximately 2.1 acres in the Kent Downs National Landscape on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham. The plot includes a driveway, triple garage and grounds extending to the boundaries.

The detached house was built in 1987 and provides four bedrooms, three bathrooms and three reception rooms. The ground floor comprises the principal reception rooms.

The kitchen opens to family space. An indoor swimming pool is housed separately.

The first floor accommodates four bedrooms and three bathrooms.

The grounds extend to approximately 2.1 acres. The triple garage provides storage and vehicle space.

Wrotham lies in Tonbridge and Malling Borough.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction: standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Building safety, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
keyFeatures: Set within approximately 2.1 acres in the Kent Downs National Landscape
